errors.text_span: no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The bars are visually emphasized with annotations. Each 'Vanilla CoT' bar has its value labeled directly above it (e.g., 92.5, 86.4). Each 'TLDR (Ours)' bar has the percentage change relative to the 'Vanilla CoT' bar annotated above it (e.g., -1.6%, +0.2%). The generation prompt explicitly lists annotations as a form of visual emphasis to be described.
